scientific_integrity: The proofs use compact invariant probabilities, exact telescoping, a quadratic inequality, and an explicit period-two construction. Computations provide corroboration and are not replacements for proofs.
scientific_limitations: Real-plane dynamics only; the sharp threshold is a parameter-uniform realizability boundary, not a universal sufficiency claim for each fixed remaining parameter. Explicit period-two witnesses are not shown attracting. Stationary bounds are necessary rather than sufficient. Priority search is not exhaustive; no independent verification is claimed.
title: Sharp compact-recurrence boundary and ballistic drift corridor for a cosine-memory map
